facts.fact: 两人牵手溜回谷仓，婚宴已近散场，只剩几名客人围坐。
facts.anchor: Amrita and Jamie snuck back into the barn, hands tightly clasped

facts.fact: Mia 笑骂他们迟到，说再不来就派 Mist 去抓人。
facts.anchor: If you kept us waiting much longer, I was going to send Mist out after you

facts.fact: Jamie 把藏好的长圆筒礼盒从角落搬上桌。
facts.anchor: He smiled at Amrita before retrieving the long, round case

facts.fact: Mia 拧开筒盖抽出纸卷递给 Aiden，说 Happy wedding day, hubby。
facts.anchor: Mia took the heavy tube from Jamie. She unscrewed the end

facts.fact: Aiden 把图纸铺满桌子，连看几张后皱眉说看不懂。
facts.anchor: Aiden chuckled as he unrolled the papers across the table

facts.fact: Amrita 抽出水彩概念图放到最上层帮他理解。
facts.anchor: She pulled it out and placed it on the top.

facts.fact: Sylvie 唱歌似地宣布这是她的新家，能更久保住独立与尊严。
facts.anchor: Sylvie almost sang the words as Aiden gawped

facts.fact: Jamie 拨开她颊边头发（小心不碰掉那朵粉花），说今后会常来 Hudsbury。
facts.anchor: He turned to her and gently pushed her hair back from her cheek
